// diagnostic

E0111

`x` was made with `::`, so it can't change

What

`x` was made with `::`, so it can't change

Why

Only `:=` bindings (and `&` parameters) can be changed

Fix

Declare it with `x := ...` instead

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0111: tests/ui/assign_to_val.stderr.

Error [E0111]: `x` was made with `::`, so it can't change
  --> tests/ui/assign_to_val.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     x = 2
    |     ^
 Why: only `:=` bindings and parameters marked with the write-access marker `&` can be changed
 Fix: declare it with `x := ...` instead
